page0.text:
"Argh!"
I hear glass shattering.
I hear the sound of intense fighting coming from the living room.
"Shirou, your orders, please. There is no time to be indecisive."
I know.
My delaying is making the situation worse.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page0:1

page1.text:
"We're going after Caster. I already said Tohsaka should take care of Illya."
"Then let us go, Master. I will entrust my back to you."
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page1:1

page2.text:
She hurries down the hall, mowing down bones as she goes.
The bone soldiers disappear before getting anywhere near Saber.
They are like vanishing snowflakes.
Saber scatters so many in her path, it looks like a snowstorm.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page2:1

page3.text:
"...Hah..."
She said she'd trust her back to me, but she pretty clearly doesn't need me to protect her.
I'm once again reminded how skilled of a swordsman Saber is.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page3:1

page4.text:
Saber charges through them, unwavering.
She cuts her way straight to the source of these bones.
Her only goal now is to defeat the yet unseen sixth Servant that has invaded the house.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page4:1

page5.text:
Saber stops.
The soldiers, which had been coming at us in droves, are suddenly gone.
This must be our destination.
A distorted human figure looms ahead of us.
It wears a robe of some kind, but the robe itself is so dark that it looks more like a hole in the night.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page5:1

page6.text:
...A dark shadow.
As soon as I lay eyes on the figure, I'm struck by an indescribable sense of anxiety.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page6:1

page7.text: "Are you Saber? Ah yes, you certainly would be capable of defeating Berserker. My soldiers, then, would be no deterrent to you."
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page7:1

page8.text:
The figure chuckles.
It seems the dark figure is the master of those bone creatures...Caster.
But...
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page8:1

page9.text:
"There's no Master..."
There's no sign of a Master nearby.
Maybe she's the same as Lancer...able to move even far from her Master.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page9:1

page10.text:
"You... Has your contract been terminated?"
Saber challenges her directly with the question.
"Yes. That...man was unfit to be my Master. So I rid myself of him. He is no more."
I can't see the expression on the robed Servant's face.
But I can hear the terrible coldness in Caster's voice.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page10:1

page11.text:
"Master-killer...so your Master..."
"He's long dead. But that is not a problem for me, Saber.
We are soul-eaters. We are surrounded on all sides by sources of magical energy.
All that remains is... Why, simply obtaining the Holy Grail. Then there is nothing else to worry about."
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page11:1

page12.text:
"So you wish to live in this world, too? I do not know what Heroic Spirit you are, but have you abandoned what pride you had for this?"
"Goodness. And would you not say letting yourself be used as a tool for humans is casting your pride aside?
I could never endure that, both then and now. I grew tired of working for another's benefit. I prefer to be the one pulling the strings. You have no right to criticize."
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page12:1

page13.text:
"I figured as much, but your misdeeds do not concern me."
Saber tilts her body just slightly.
She's only about ten meters from Caster.
Saber should be able to close that distance and bring Caster down in a heartbeat.
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page13:1

page14.text:
"How nasty of you. I came here simply to talk, but you will not hear me? I will have you know, I've been gentle here."
"There is nothing for us to discuss. You will die here."
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page14:1

page15.text:
Saber is intent only on killing.
...I'm not about to oppose her in this case.
All I smell from Caster is blood.
She must be telling the truth about murdering her Master.
Her raid tonight was clearly intended to kill everyone in the house.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page15:1

page16.text:
"..."
So there's no reason for me to stop Saber.
Besides, Caster isn't even a threat to Saber.
Even I can see Caster's abilities.
She is the weakest when it comes to one-to-one combat.
If Saber engages her, she can only lose.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page16:1

page17.text:
"Don't do it, Saber..."
Even with all of that in mind, I can't shake off this sense of anxiety.
It's not the same feeling of hopeless, inevitable death I got whenever we were in Berserker's presence.
Do I just have some sort of aversion to her, or is it a warning of something dangerous?
Forget about me... Somehow, my left hand is aching to warn me that Saber should stay away from that thing.
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page17:1

page18.text:
"Gh—!?"
I hesitated too long.
Saber launches herself at the dark shadow.
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page18:1

page19.text:
Caster smiles.
She doesn't look at all disturbed as Saber rushes toward her.
"."
She mutters, "Atlas."
I can't understand what she says, but it sends something beyond words straight into our minds.
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page19:1

page20.text:
The world lurches and distorts.
The air grows denser around Saber.
"Wha...!?"
I hear...even feel a tremendous impact.
The ground flexes like something massive slammed into Saber from above.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page20:1

page21.text:
"No way...she activated some kind of magecraft without moving a muscle!?"
Actually, I think she murmured something like an incantation...
Incantations can be shortened. The simpler the magecraft, the shorter the spell can be made.
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page21:1

page22.text:
But this isn't by any means simple magecraft.
Not many mages could visualize such a thing in a single breath.
Even if it were possible, they'd need to prepare a catalyst ahead of time, like Tohsaka does.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page22:1

page23.text:
But Caster triggered the magecraft with a murmured word.
I have never even heard of anything like this.
If that is Caster's magecraft, she is no mere mage.
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page23:1

page24.text:
"Saber!!!"
Saber hovers there, frozen.
Her feet still kick in midair.
She hangs, suspended there.
The air around her seems to have thickened into gelatin.
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page24:1

page25.text:
"Gh—!?"
I can't get close. Some sort of invisible barrier holds me back.
The murkiness seems confined to Saber, but so long as her feet don't touch the ground, she can't move.
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page25:1

page26.text:
"You underestimated me, Saber. I don't know how your mages fared in your life, but I lived during the Age of Gods.
To these modern mages, what I do must seem like Magic."
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page26:1

page27.text:
A ridiculing laugh echoes out from the depths of that dark robe.
Saber is still suspended, helpless, in the air.
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page27:1

page28.text: "Oh? Is this really all you are capable of, Caster?"
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page28:1

page29.text: She dismisses this as if it were some dull trick.
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page29:1

page30.text:
"Magic Resistance!? It repels even my magecraft!?"
Caster steps back.
After casually nullifying Caster's magecraft, Saber surges toward her at lightning speed.
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page30:1

page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-04:page31:1
